title: Oxtail Stew
subtitle: Jamaican slow-braised oxtail with butter beans
excerpt: Jamaican oxtail stew is the ultimate slow-cook -- gelatinous pieces of oxtail braised for hours in a dark, rich sauce of allspice, soy, and thyme until the meat falls from the bone. Butter beans are added at the end. This is a dish worth planning ahead for.
sourceNotes: Oxtail is one of the most celebrated dishes of Jamaican cooking. It was historically considered offal -- affordable food for working people -- and the long braise transforms it into something extraordinary. Jamaican-style oxtail is distinguished by its use of soy sauce, allspice, and Worcestershire sauce.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freezes well for up to 3 months. Cool completely before freezing.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Cook 1 day ahead and reheat gently -- the flavour improves overnight.

content.text: Oxtail needs a minimum of 2.5 to 3 hours. There are no shortcuts. The collagen in the bones melts into the sauce and gives it a glossy, sticky quality that no other cut can replicate. Butter beans -- or kidney beans -- are added in the last 30 minutes.

items.prepNote: use butter beans or kidney beans (tinned, drained)

content.text: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees. Season the oxtail generously with salt.
Heat the oil in a large heavy casserole over high heat. Brown the oxtail pieces in batches until deeply coloured on all sides. Remove and set aside.
Cook the onion in the same pot for 7 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the brown sugar and allspice. Stir for 1 minute until the sugar melts.
Return the oxtail. Add the soy sauce, carrots, thyme, bay leaves, chilli flakes, and stock. Bring to the boil.
Cover tightly and cook in the oven for 2.5 to 3 hours until the meat is falling off the bone.
Add the butter beans. Return to the oven uncovered for 20 minutes. Skim off any fat from the surface. Rest for 10 minutes. Serve with rice and peas.

items.symptom: Meat is still tough after 2.5 hours
items.cause: Oxtail can vary enormously in size and age
items.fix: Continue braising for another 30 minutes; the meat is done when it pulls away from the bone with a spoon

items.cause: Oxtail is a fatty cut and the fat renders during braising
items.fix: Skim the surface with a spoon, or chill overnight and lift the solidified fat off the top

items.cause: Too much stock or not enough reduction time
items.fix: Remove the lid and reduce the sauce on the hob for 10 minutes before serving

content.text: Oxtail stew is one of the cornerstones of Jamaican cooking. It is served in homes and restaurants across the island and in the Jamaican diaspora communities of London, New York, and Toronto. It is Sunday food at its most serious -- the kind of dish that requires hours and rewards patience with something unforgettable.
